4379.title: [skia-sync] Merge upstream chrome/m150 bug fixes
4379.author: mattleibow
4379.body:
[skia-sync] Merge upstream chrome/m150 bug fixes (#4379)

Companion: mono/skia#281
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/280ec21ada...ef2ebb78c8
Upstream CL: https://skia-review.googlesource.com/c/skia/+/1288679
Bug: skia:530646115 / Chromium 532102500

Advance the externals/skia submodule (and cgmanifest.json) on the
release/4.150.x line to mono/skia@ef2ebb78c8, pulling in one upstream
chrome/m150 bug fix:

  * Fix Use-After-Free in SubRunAllocator (google/skia@3273c66a68)

Deserializing a corrupt Slug buffer (SlugImpl::MakeFromBuffer) returns
nullptr early and destroys a std::tuple whose member destruction order is
unspecified, so SubRunInitializer freed the backing memory before
~BagOfBytes in the SubRunAllocator read fEndByte out of it -- a
use-after-free read followed by a wild-free/double-free. Upstream replaces
the tuple with a struct that guarantees the allocator destructs before the
initializer frees the memory. See mono/skia#281 for the full analysis.

Submodule bump only: cgmanifest.json commitHash tracks the new mono/skia
commit; chrome_milestone (150) and upstream_merge_commit (3273c66a68) are
unchanged (same-milestone release-line sync, no version bump). The upstream
change is internal C++ (src/text/gpu/SubRunAllocator.h) with no C API or
binding impact -- binding regeneration produced zero diff and the full
SkiaSharp.Tests.Console suite passed (5584 passed, 0 failed, 172 skipped)
on Linux x64.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
